svg.text: AQUATRACK3-GPT-CLAUDE_1 / FIELD GUIDE
Start here. Run a complete working day.
Source-based instructions • Open the SVG to zoom • Read the full README
01 PREPARE
JDK 25+ • Desktop • MySQL / MariaDB
Build Aquatrack3-gpt-claude_1 from source.
Configure the JDBC URL, database user and password.
Properties override environment variables, then defaults.
02 INITIALIZE
New database → schema → first owner
Import schema.sql into an empty selected database.
Generate a PBKDF2 password hash; bootstrap one owner.
App logins and database credentials are separate.
03 SET UP THE STATION
Products → Stock → Customers → Riders
Owner sets pickup and delivery refill prices.
Receive stock for containers and caps/seals.
Create individual Staff / Owner/Admin login accounts.
04 OPERATE AND REVIEW
Sell → Deliver → Collect → Reconcile
Save each sale once, then preview / print its receipt.
Record credit collections and gallon returns separately.
Review sales, unpaid balances and stock; back up MySQL.
